notes.title: Big update 0.7
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980069/3fcf31c6e84b7a80ca03055c6e15285a3d7ef0f0.png[/img]

In this update May have an impact on former players Because I have found The game has quests and missions that give unreasonable rewards. and making the goal of the game unclear Previously, blueprints were obtained by Level up your character Makes it difficult to reach players So I asked to change the blueprint request to request a quest reward instead. This will result in all old players' blueprints disappearing. And will get new ones from completing quests instead. To see the guidelines and what the players should do next in the game loop.
This may have an impact on former players. If there are any bugs or you find anything unusual caused by the quest, you can contact support.

- Changed quest rewards and removed blueprints obtained from leveling up.
- Fixed animal and weapon collider bugs to make attacks easier

We apologize for the inconvenience for former players. We really need it. In order for players to receive the most entertainment
Thank you for your support. This game was developed by a single developer. It might not be a perfect game. But I promise to continue improving to make this game the best it can be.

notes.title: Update 0.3 released !
notes.notes:
[h3][b]More New Features to Explore[/b][/h3]

Hey, one who remained friends! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980069/0ca09a28992e58fbdf5aae5f27d9c2ea1bf0d182.png[/img]

[h3][b]An empty bunker[/b][/h3]

It's both dark and dangerous. You are the only survivor in this bunker. You wake up and find that The people around you are transformed into eerie monsters. "Wendigo" are humans affected by the process. metamorphosis until evolution causes the body to become larger Longer arms and legs Claws become sharper. All of this is used to hunt prey. Loss of intelligence. This process has the sole purpose of being able to survive in this harsh environment. That's right, I'm talking about the toxic place

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980069/71952380bd78a6bd3a1b642759a0d06c44007985.png[/img]

The bunker is full of mechanics, puzzles and items.

And of course, this isn't the only bunker out there. Try searching for another bunker. In case there are still any survivors left.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980069/8e50d27edc32951882391ae904c2374bc027290b.png[/img]

Or else, other places are full of people who have become wedigo.
